caption:
Paneer Tikka Open Toastie 
 protein | make ahead | meal prep friendly 

Nutrition: 
Macros: C: 34 | F: 16 | P: 18
Calories: 384 per serve 
Makes 4 sourdough toasties 

Ingredients 
200 grams paneer, can be subbed with tofu or chicken too 
1 onion, thinly sliced 
1 capsicum, thinly sliced
marinade
3 tbsp thick curd
1 tsp ginger garlic paste
1 tsp red chilli powder
1 tsp haldi powder
1 tsp coriander powder
1 tsp garam masala
1 tsp chaat masala 
Salt to taste

1 tbsp green chutney 
60 grams cheese of choice 
4 slices sourdough 

Method 
marinate paneer as per ingredients mentioned above
set aside in the fridge till ready to cook
cook the marinated paneer in a non stick pan, you dont need any oil for this 

to assemble, toast sourdough then add on green chutney, cooked paneer and vegetables and some grated cheese :) 

pro tip: i garnish with pickled green chillies which tastes SO good!!
